doc.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The 1974 Josephine Baker tribute at Carnegie Hall
summary: The tribute, with Teddy Wilson and Thelma Carpenter, was her first Carnegie Hall appearance and a new beginning.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans

blocks.x: How about 1974, the tribute to Josephine Baker at Carnegie Hall. Did that represent kind of a new beginning in the ‘70’s for you?
Yes it did. Because I hadn’t played Carnegie Hall. I wanted to play on that with Thelma Carpenter, she really didn’t want me on the bill, but I was hired.
And what did the tribute to Josephine Baker consist of?
Me, Teddy Wilson and Thelma Carpenter.
